title: Domestic agreements when circumstances change
meaning: Your domestic agreement keeps its supporting role when changed circumstances lead to a proportionate correction instead of constant reassessment of your whole shared life.
text: You can build domestic life through fair recognition of capacity: agreeing on essentials, noticing the load and changing its division according to facts. Justice in the physical position of Muladhara describes these actions. Judgement in energy complicates them through constantly demanding fresh reflection on the entire domestic arrangement. The Wheel of Fortune in emotions feels changing circumstances and responses. Together, this can give an ordinary correction excessive weight: each new rhythm seems grounds for deciding whether your whole shared life is properly arranged.

For example, grocery delivery times change and the usual dinner preparation no longer fits. Instead of moving one task, conversation turns to every previous decision. **One changed condition does not require reviewing your entire shared path.** Understanding what each can now manage allows the agreement to be clarified. The new week gains workable support, while its difference from the last does not become compulsory evidence of a longstanding mistake.

The difficulty is expecting another review to deliver a final answer after which circumstances stop interfering. They change nevertheless, and discussion encompasses the whole home again. A more precise scale supports you: the meaning of shared life can be preserved while one action changes. A variable mood then need not immediately decide the value of everything you have already done together.
